source.inspectionScope: Full owned 13-file ESR rollover diff read. Selected project parameter producer/consumer, scope alias installation, update-filter/command transform and next-update task config read. Historical snap release selection checked because the actual review discusses an older-diff snap change. Fixed ESR153 values read as a separate stage. No graph generation, release promotion or updater execution. Suite-only code excluded.
